 Follow Thursday's European games live
 2026년 10월 22일 목 오후 3:55 UTC 0 There are 18 games in both the Europa League and the Conference League on Thursday - with Bournemouth, Crystal Palace and Sunderland involved in the former, and Brighton the latter - and BBC Sport will bring you every moment.
 Jablonev v Brighton (17:45)
 Lech Poznan v Sunderland (17:45)
 Besiktas v Crystal Palace
 Bournemouth v AC Milan
 Kick-off times 20:00 BST unless stated. 
 Follow all of the action and reaction here 
 New this season: Live match updates 
 Fans of Premier League clubs can now get real-time scores live on their phone lock screen for every game.
 Simply follow your favourite football teams on the BBC Sport app for updates throughout the 2026-27 season.
